module_summary: Small synchronous FIFO: a 4-entry register array with read/write pointers and an occupancy counter deriving valid (not empty) and accept (not full).

anchors.name: ram_q
anchors.why: 4-entry data array written at wr_ptr_q on push, read at rd_ptr_q.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_q
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing ram_q; increments on accepted push.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_q
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting data_out_o; increments on valid pop.

anchors.name: count_q
anchors.why: Occupancy count; drives valid_o (non-empty) and accept_o (non-full).

anchors.name: push_i
anchors.why: Push request; with accept_o writes data and advances write pointer.

anchors.name: pop_i
anchors.why: Pop request from consumer; advances read pointer.

anchors.name: data_in_i
anchors.why: Write data stored into ram_q on push.

anchors.name: data_out_o
anchors.why: Head-of-FIFO data read from ram_q at rd_ptr_q.

groups.name: fifo_control
groups.description: Pointers and occupancy counter producing full/empty handshakes.
